This analysis will support the tailoring of the instrument design to meet a specific set of Level 1 requirements while also informing the scientific community about how sensitive these performance parameters are to overall instrument complexity. Ultimately, the study will used as an input to define an optimal set of mission requirements and identifying a suitable instrument concept for a bistatic ROSE L companion satellite.
